description: BackEndDriven 日志消息定义 - 使用 ClassName_MethodName_description 命名 | ★ 2026-08-08 级别降噪：Command_Get(读取成功)→Debug（消除配置 JSON 重复读取/空值读取刷屏；与 Command_Set/Click/Validate_Success 对齐）

Command_Sideload_Render_Succeeded.template: sideload 渲染成功 — scope={scope}, config={configPath}, nodeCount={nodeCount}, hostChildCount={hostChildCount}

Command_Sideload_Render_Failed.template: sideload 渲染失败 — scope={scope}, config={configPath}, error={error}, nodeCount={nodeCount}, hostChildCount={hostChildCount}

Command_Sideload_Config_NotResolved.template: sideload 配置解析失败（文件不存在）— target={target}, resolved={fullPath}

WorkflowMethodExecution_Start.template: [WorkflowMethodExecution] 开始执行工作流: Function='{functionName}', InputControls='{inputControls}', IsGuiMode={isGuiMode}

WorkflowMethodExecution_Complete.template: [WorkflowMethodExecution] 工作流执行完成: Function='{functionName}', TotalTime={time}ms

WorkflowMethodExecution_Cancelled.template: [WorkflowMethodExecution] 工作流执行被取消: Function='{functionName}'

WorkflowMethodExecution_Error.template: [WorkflowMethodExecution] 工作流执行失败: Function='{functionName}', Error={error}

FrameworkExecutor_Complete.template: [FrameworkExecutor] 工作流执行完成: Success={success}, Time={time}ms

Command_Sleep.template: [Command] 声明内等待: action={action}, sleepMs={sleepMs}（等待本身不计为慢/卡；见 CommandCoordinator 声明内等待豁免）

Command_Click_NotDispatched.template: [Command] 点击未分发（目标未渲染或无匹配绑定）: target={target}, outcome={outcome}

Command_Validate_TextMatch.template: [Command] 文本匹配: target={target}, expected={expected}, actual={actual}

Command_Validate_PositionMatch.template: [Command] 位置匹配: target={target}, expected=({expectedX},{expectedY}), actual=({actualX},{actualY})

Command_Validate_NotMounted.template: [Command] validate 失败: 控件存在但未挂载到可见窗体（孤儿控件）— target={target}, note={note}

Command_Validate_Fallback_PoolExistence.template: [Command] validate 池直查降级（控件未挂载到可见窗体树）: target={target}, note={note}

Command_Validate_Mount_Success.template: [Command] 挂载断言通过: target={target}, parent={parent}, visible={visible}

Command_Assert_Container.template: [Command] 容器断言通过: hostName={hostName}, actual={actual}, expected={expected}

Command_Assert_EventBound.template: [Command] 断言事件绑定: controlName={controlName}, subscribed={subscribed}

Command_Assert_TextContains.template: [Command] 断言文本包含（assert text-contains）通过: controlName={controlName}, expected={expected}

Command_Assert_TextContains_Mismatch.template: [Command] assert text-contains 失配（控件文本不含期望子串，命令将计 FAIL）: controlName={controlName}, expected={expected}, len={len}, actual={actual}

Command_Exec_Sync.template: [Command] 同步执行函数: function={function}, timeoutMs={timeoutMs}, output={output}

Command_Exec_Success.template: [Command] 函数执行成功: function={function}, result={result}

Command_Exec_Failed.template: [Command] 函数执行失败: function={function}, error={error}

Command_Exec_Error.template: [Command] 函数执行异常: function={function}, error={error}

Command_Exec_ExpectedContains_Match.template: [Command] exec 结果断言通过（函数返回文本含期望子串）: function={function}, expectedContains={expectedContains}

Command_Exec_ExpectedContains_Mismatch.template: [Command] exec 结果断言失配（函数返回即 success 但结果不达标 → fail-fast）: function={function}, expectedContains={expectedContains}, actual={actual}

Command_Load_ActiveScope.template: [Command] 加载后置活动作用域: scope={scope}

Command_Await_Timeout.template: [Command] 等待超时: target={target}, key={key}, timeoutMs={timeoutMs}

Command_ClickWait_Success.template: [Command] click 等待函数完成成功: target={target}, output={output}

FunctionExecutor_DelegateFailed.template: [FuncExec] 委托执行失败 — method={method}, errorType={errorType}, error={error}, elapsedMs={elapsedMs}

AEF_OpTerminated.template: [AEF] 操作非正常终止 — name={name}, phase={phase}, elapsedMs={elapsedMs}, error={error}

InvocationKernel_Terminated.template: [InvocationKernel] 函数框架态终止 — functionName={functionName}, outcome={outcome}, elapsedMs={elapsedMs}, stages={stages}, error={error}

CommandCoordinator_realtime_slow.template: [CommandCoordinator] 运行期慢(疑似卡死): #{index} {rawCommand} (action={action}, target={target}, elapsedMs={elapsedMs})

CommandCoordinator_realtime_failure.template: [CommandCoordinator] 运行期命令失败: #{index} {rawCommand} (action={action}, target={target}) error={error}, elapsedMs={elapsedMs}
